_about: The Archer's cards (the Archer document, 13-archer.md). One source per card: book/cards/README.md. Mark Quarry is Foundry-only. Pack R-classes (2026-11-04): the class rebuilt for 4 AP + 1 Reaction AP and Escalation as a level (book/rework-r.md sections 12 and 14).

cards.name: Sharpshooter
cards.flavor: You were made for the shot no one else would take.
cards.text: Choose your Hallmark Action: **Double Shot** or **Rolling Shot**. Choose one [[Projectile]] weapon, such as a bow or a crossbow: you start with **3 Mastery** with it. Your [Shot] Actions don't take the Bane for targeting a creature Engaged with a creature other than you.

cards.name: Marked Quarry
cards.flavor: You pick the one, and the world narrows.
cards.text: At the start of each encounter, choose one enemy as your **Marked Quarry**. You gain 1 Boon on [Shot, Strike] Actions against them, and those Actions deal [V] [Mod] on a Tier 1. When they die or go Down, you can choose a new Marked Quarry (0R [Focus]). Once per turn, you can change your Marked Quarry during an encounter by spending 1 AP [Focus].

settings.text: choose a creature to mark. Target it and use your marking Action:
your mark, {mark}, went Down. Choose a new one: target a creature and use your marking Action:

cards.name: Thrill of the Kill
cards._note: Pack R-classes (2026-11-04): the Archer's Escalation hook (rework-r.md 12.8; Core Rules, Escalation).
cards.flavor: The first one falls, and the rest of the world sharpens.
cards.text: Once an encounter, when your Marked Quarry goes Down, your [[Escalation]] increases by 1.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: raise your Escalation by hand.)

cards.name: Double Shot
cards.flavor: Two shots, so close together they sound like one.

versions.effects: You make two [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attacks (1A), each against a different creature.

versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack x2 | different | evade 1

cards.name: Rolling Shot
cards.flavor: You keep moving, and the shot rides along with the motion.

versions.effects: Evade 1, then make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A).
Evade 2, then make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) that deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each extra 1d6 | evade 2

versions.effects: Evade 3, then make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) that deals an extra [V] 2d6 Pi.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each extra 2d6 | evade 3

cards.name: Overwatch
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 4 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the Archer's own moment, movement: "moves closer" (Chapter 2, Moving Closer: once per Advance, never on an Evade or Forced Movement), Hindered (EoT) on a hit (Chapter 8: halves the movement it has left), Pushed 2 on a Critical. The Strike-trigger version measured 1.2 AP a turn; this one fires less (rclasses.md section 6).
cards.flavor: Nothing moves in your sight without an arrow following it.
cards.trigger: An enemy within 10 squares moves closer to you or to an ally.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) against the triggering creature. On a Tier 2 or 3, it is Hindered (EoT); on a Critical, it is also Pushed 2.

foundry.automationNote: the Weapon Attack (the button); the trigger is by hand.

cards.name: Covering Shot
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 4 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): the Archer's mercy Reaction and its only Interrupt (Shield of Faith's moment), in Ready Shot's place (0.2-0.35 AP: the 3-Strike cap). 1 Boon on the shot to bring it to about 1 AP.
cards.flavor: You see the blow coming before they do, and your bolt gets there first.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the attacker. On a Tier 3, the ally takes half of the triggering damage.

foundry.automationNote: the Weapon Attack with its Boon (the button); halving the ally's damage by hand.

cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage an ally within 10 squares.

cards.name: Marksman's Shot
cards.flavor: One shot, carefully placed. Everything after it is easier.
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the Encounter ceilings (decision sheet item 16): 3d6 / 4d6 became 2d6 / 3d6. Part 4: a Critical row, Blinded (EoT) (6.7 DE on one Tier 3 in twelve).

cards.name: Volley
cards.flavor: You empty the quiver skyward, and the arrows fall together.

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.flavor: Nobody walks through that ground without paying for it.

versions.effects: For 3 rounds (the area doesn't move), enemies in the area take 1 Bane on [Strike] Actions, and allies in it gain +1 Defense.
versions.ruler: rounds 3 | area 2 | allies 2 | banes 1 strike; defense 1 allies

foundry.automationNote: the Bane and +1 Defense for creatures in the area (the area is placed and kept for 3 rounds).

cards.name: Pinning Shot
cards.flavor: You pin their foot to the ground with an arrow.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged] Weapon Attack (1A). On a Tier 2 or 3, the target is Immobilized (EoT).
versions.ruler: vs ad | tiers 0 / 1[W] + [Mod] / 1[W] + [Mod] | on 2+: debuff Immobilized (EoT)

cards._note: Pack R-classes: an Encounter Pick, no Escalation needed (decision sheet item 15; it was a Round Escalation Active worth 1 to 2 damage a fight).

cards.name: Twin Shot
cards.flavor: Two arrows, one motion, two answers.

versions.effects: Make one [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) and compare its result to two different creatures no more than 5 squares apart. It deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi to each of them.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each extra 1d6 | area 2

cards._note: Pack R-classes: an Encounter Pick, no Escalation needed (decision sheet item 15). "Two creatures" needs two targets (Core Rules, Targets).

cards.name: Hunter's Focus
cards.flavor: You and the quarry, and nothing else in the world.

versions.effects: For the rest of the encounter, against your Marked Quarry (a new Marked Quarry when you choose one): you gain 1 Boon and Empowered 1 against them, and you take less damage from each of their Actions, reduced by your **Signature Modifier** (you choose which instance of its damage is reduced).
versions.ruler: always: boon 1 encounter shot strike quarry; empowered 1 encounter shot strike quarry

foundry.automationNote: the damage reduction against your Marked Quarry (lower the damage yourself).

cards.name: Deadeye
cards.flavor: You put everything into one shot, and everything into the one after.

versions.critical: The target is Blinded for 1 round.

foundry.automationNote: Favored (tick it in the roll dialog).

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.flavor: Arrows fall from nothing, again and again, until the ground is gone.

cards.name: Killer's Focus
cards.flavor: First blood is the only blood that matters.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, your first [Shot, Strike, Weapon] Action each round that deals damage deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.

ruler.passive: escalation 1: extra 1d6 first-hit shot strike weapon

cards._note: Pack R-classes: the Escalation 1 wrath pick (it needed Escalation 2); "that deals damage" as Radiant Zeal says (rework-r.md 14.4, Lucas's answer in 14.3): about 0.5 AP a turn.

cards.name: Harrying Shots
cards.flavor: Every arrow says the same thing: not yet.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, the first time each round you deal damage to your Marked Quarry with a [Shot] Action, they take 1 Bane on [Strike] Actions until the end of their next turn.

foundry.automationNote: apply the Harried effect from the compendium.
foundry.append: (Apply the Harried effect from the compendium.)

cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 4 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): kept as it was (a Bane on the Quarry's Strikes); Frightened of you on every Shot, with no Save, was too strong.

cards.name: Vanish
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the 0R Reaction the rung grants (decision sheet item 15, revised in 14.3 with Chapter 3's movement words; the old Evade 2 and +1 Defense every turn are gone).
cards.flavor: They reach for you, and you are already somewhere else.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, you have the **Vanish** Reaction (0R, Round). **Interrupt:** An enemy would enter a square adjacent to you during a Move Action. You can Evade 1.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: use Evade by hand when it triggers.)

cards.name: Hunter's Edge
cards._note: Pack R-classes: new, the Escalation 2 wrath pick (rung budget 0.6-0.8 AP a turn): ignoring Cover is about 1.5 DE a turn for an Archer (positions: its shots carry 1.6 Banes from the map, Cover on half of them), the 1d4 about 2 (a flat +2 on every Shot against the Quarry measured 1.1 AP on a four-shot turn: rclasses.md section 6).
cards.flavor: You know where it will be before it does.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, your [Shot] Actions against your Marked Quarry ignore Cover, and the first one each round that deals damage deals an extra [V] 1d4 Pi.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: untick Cover and add [V] 1d4 Pi by hand.)

cards.name: Sure Step
cards._note: Pack R-classes: new, the Escalation 2 mobility pick (a free step each round: the Archer starts about half its turns Engaged, and stepping away costs it 1 AP: positions, book/ruler/README.md).
cards.flavor: Loose, step, and let them wonder where the next one comes from.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, once a round, when you deal damage to your Marked Quarry with a [Shot] Action, you can Evade 1.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: use Evade by hand after the Shot.)

cards.name: Finisher
cards._note: Pack R-classes: new, the Escalation 3 wrath pick (rung budget 0.8-1 AP a turn on the turns at Escalation 3: 1d8 on the first landing Shot is about 4.5 DE, 0.8 AP; 2d6 was 1.2: rclasses.md section 6; Reckoning's twin); it pays the Bloodied / Strained hooks.
cards.flavor: A wounded thing runs in a straight line.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more, the first [Shot] Action you make each round that deals damage to a Bloodied or Strained creature deals an extra [V] 1d8 Pi.

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: add [V] 1d8 Pi by hand, once a round, against a Bloodied or Strained target.)

cards.name: Staggering Shot
cards._note: Pack R-classes, part 4 (Lucas, 2026-11-04): was Pinned Down (Immobilized (EoT) each round: 7.3 DE at the refreshed prices, 1.26 AP, over the rung's 0.8-1); Dazed 1 (2.4) and Hindered (EoT) (1.5): about 0.67 AP.
cards.flavor: The bolt knocks the wind out of them.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more, the first time each round you deal damage to your Marked Quarry with a [Shot] Action, they are Dazed 1 and Hindered (EoT).

foundry.append: (Not automated until R-Foundry: Dazed 1 and Hindered on the Quarry by hand.)

cards.name: Deathmark
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the wrath Apex (decision sheet item 14: Encounter, Escalation 3, 2 AP at the Encounter band, within the ceilings: Holy Wrath 2's dice). An Archer's shot is already 7 to 8 DE with the Quarry's Boon, so 2d6 / 3d6 was no better than its Main turn (rclasses.md section 6). The chain on a kill pays the hook (a new Quarry, a free shot).
cards.flavor: One arrow, one name, and nothing left to argue.

versions.effects: Against your Marked Quarry, this Action has 1 Boon. If the target goes Down, you can choose a new Marked Quarry (0R) and make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) against them.

foundry.automationNote: the Boon against the Quarry (the mark) and the Weapon Attack (the button); the new Quarry by hand.

cards.name: Open Season
cards._note: Pack R-classes: the setup Apex (decision sheet item 14; 14.3: each class gets a setup or compression card): its own shot, then Vulnerable 2 on the Quarry for a round (about 3 attackers × 1.5 Strikes × 2 Boons) and the allies' extra dice: about 25 DE for 2 AP, the Encounter band. (Without its own shot it measured below the Main turn: rclasses.md section 6.)
cards.flavor: You call it, and every arrow in the party finds the mark.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) against your Marked Quarry. Until the end of your next turn, they are Vulnerable 2, and [Strike] Actions your allies make against them deal an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | always: vulnerable 2 round

foundry.automationNote: the Weapon Attack (the button); Vulnerable 2 on the Quarry (drop the condition by hand); the allies add [V] 1d6 Pi by hand.

cards.name: Mark Quarry
cards._note: Foundry only (v0.0.186): the Action Marked Quarry grants to mark a creature; the book's Marked Quarry text covers it.
cards.flavor: One name, one face, and the rest of the field goes quiet.

versions.effects: The targeted creature becomes your Marked Quarry: at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R [Focus] when yours died or went Down.
The targeted creature becomes your Marked Quarry instead of the one you had (once per turn).
